fingerprints.story: The storm had been raging for three days, a relentless assault of salt spray and howling wind that battered the granite walls of the Blackwood Point Lighthouse. Inside the lantern room, Elias Thorne sat hunched over his workbench, the rhythmic *tick-tock* of the great Fresnel lens rotating above him serving as the only counterpoint to the gale outside. In his hands, he held the broken heart of his only companion: a clockwork nighting
